name: The Reprise

do.objective: The brass key is in the warehouse, the brass door is south of it
The brass key. The brass door is on the south side of the quay
The town: through the lanes to the south-west gap
The house on the hill: its tower has the exit

intro.title: THE REPRISE
lines: A harbour, a town and a hill, built from what the grafted remember of them.
The pier is on the wrong side. The sea is glass. Everything is in the right place.

outro: The tower door opened on a stair, and the stair went down into the dark with the same care for the treads as every stair in this country. The lamp on the hill was never lit.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The pier again, the other way round. The boats are where the boats were. The water is glass and nothing is moving under it.

messages.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE
messages.text: Calder, come in. The bells are ringing. Nobody rings the bells at night. The ferry is alongside at the north pier, engines running.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The ferry was dead in the water. You told me so yourself. It has the voice right and the ferry wrong.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The harbour crew in their oilskins again, in crystal this time, standing where they stood. Something has copied them down to the buttons.

messages.speaker: CUSTOMS MANIFEST
messages.text: 212 persons received. 212 processed. Signed for by no one. Under it in a second hand: KEPT AS COPIES: 213.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The brass door is where it was. The brass key is where it lay, in the warehouse behind the plaza.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The jetty goes on over the glass. It was not here. Somebody wanted the way out to be easy to find.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The lamp in the net-loft is the only one on this quay that is warm to hold. The rest are glass.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: The Hive copied the lamps and could not copy the light. Take the warm one, and keep it low.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A street of the right width and the wrong houses. The doors are where doors are at home, and there is nobody behind any of them.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The hill, and a house on the top of it with the aerial up. It is the right size. The lamp beside it is not lit.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The exit is at the top of the tower, up the stair at the back of the house.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The tower door. Past it the stair goes down, and it is cold.

objective: Take the quay as you took it the first time: the brass key, the brass door. Then the town, and the house on the hill

quality.introduces: recognition: the committed plan of Marrow Quay mirrored in crystal, its creatures where they stood, the brass key and the brass door where they were
